POLICE OVERSIGHT COMMISSION MINUTES

Dr. Naida Tushnet, Chair  David Ochoa, Commissioner
Charlyn Bender, Vice Chair  Otieno Okatch, Commissioner
Dr. Tiffany Brown, Commissioner  Gus Orozco, Commissioner
Edgar Campbell, Commissioner

  Francine Kerridge, Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:02 PM, Chair Tushnet called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bender, Campbell, Ochoa, Okatch, Orozco, Tushnet

Commissioners Absent: Brown

Also present: Francine Kerridge, Director, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, Millicent Usoro,
Deputy City Attorney, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst.

Commissioner Brown was excused from the meeting.

ELECTION OF CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR

A motion was made by Commissioner Orozco, seconded by Commissioner Bender, to elect
Chair Tushnet for Chair of the Police Oversight Commission. The motion carried by the
following vote:

Yes:  6  Bender, Campbell, Ochoa, Okatch, Orozco, Tushnet
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  1  Brown

A motion was made by Commissioner Orozco, seconded by Commissioner Okatch, to elect
Commissioner Bender for Vice Chair of the Police Oversight Commission. The
motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  6  Bender, Campbell, Ochoa, Okatch, Orozco, Tushnet
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  1  Brown

Francine Kerridge, Director of Police Oversight, spoke.

Commissioner Ochoa spoke.

Chair Tushnet declared the nominations open for Chair.

Commissioner Orozco nominated Chair Tushnet for Chair of the Police Oversight Commission.

Chair Tushnet declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Orozco nominated Commissioner Bender for Vice Chair of the Police Oversight
Commission.
